Name: Romantic Revenue
Author: Astraios911
Description:
Ever wished your spouse chipped in a bit more? This mod lets your significant other show some love with a little financial help! Look forward to finding sweet notes and some extra cash in your mailbox every few days, and now some NPCs will also hand over their contributions during conversations! [b]Also, please endorse if you like the mod[/b] ❤️


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/dTeBJq5.png[/img][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Found a bug?[/b] If you come across any bugs, please report them in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27043?tab=bugs]Bugs[/url]﻿ tab so I can address them as soon as possible.
[*][b]Found a typo?[/b] If you spot any translation issues or mistakes, please report them in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2560]Typos[/url]﻿.
[*][b]Have a suggestion?[/b] I'm always open to ideas! Whether it's a new feature, a tweak to the existing system, or anything in between, you can share your ideas in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2561]Suggestions[/url]﻿.
[*][b]Want to contribute alternative dialogues or mail?[/b] Keeping the game fresh and engaging is important. So, if you have ideas for new dialogues or mail, feel free to create them and send them in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2562]Alternatives[/url]﻿. I’d love to include community contributions in the mod to keep it varied and interesting for everyone. And of course, I will credit you!
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/eopkM16.png[/img]﻿[/center]

[list]
[*]Spouses with jobs now contribute a portion of their income to your shared fund.
[*]Receive heartwarming letters & dialogue alongside the financial boost. (Note: you don't get both letters and dialogue, you get only one depending on the NPC)
[*]Adds a touch of realism and makes both checking your mail and talking to your spouse more rewarding.
[/list]
Here is a list of all supported NPCs, including their sources of income and earnings. [b]Please keep in mind that not all are created equal, and all of the incomes are configurable. [/b]So, you can adjust the amount of money you get to what you think is a suitable amount.
